title: Fastrack Lending — Mortgage Lender Website
tagline: A fast, transparent mortgage lending site — purchase, refinance, and investor loan applications built to move borrowers from browsing to approved.
overview: Fastrack Lending is a licensed mortgage lender (NMLS #2135873) offering purchase, refinance, and investor loans. As lead programmer, I built their public-facing site — a multistep loan application flow, dedicated purchase/refinance/investor loan pages, and an FAQ designed to move borrowers from browsing to a submitted application with as little friction as possible.
problem: Mortgage applications are notoriously slow and confusing for borrowers, and most lender sites do a poor job of building trust or making the first step — getting pre-approved — feel fast and low-risk.
solution: Built a WordPress site on Elementor Pro with a Contact Form 7 multistep application flow, dedicated pages for purchase, refinance, and investor loan programs, and a results-first homepage layout that leads with the numbers borrowers actually care about — approval odds, closing speed, and satisfaction.
results: Live and processing applications. Fastrack Lending reports 60% faster closings than traditional lenders, a 97% approval rate, and 98% client satisfaction on the platform.
